leafcut.name: LeafCut

entryPoints.label: LeafCut (dialog window)
entryPoints.where: Reopening adds meshes to the open dialog. Source/LeafCutEditor/Private/SLeafCutDialog.cpp:735-766

entryPoints.label: Drop static or skeletal meshes here.

workflow.storesSettings: Last-used dialog choices only, per user (EditorPerProjectUserSettings), saved on Convert; nothing stored on assets (LeafCutEditorSettings.h:92-99; SLeafCutDialog.cpp:974-983)
workflow.rerunnable: Reopen dialog and convert again; same output name replaces the existing asset (SLeafCutDialog.cpp:877-879)
workflow.preview: None; only per-row validation errors/warnings before Convert (SLeafCutDialog.cpp:808-949)
workflow.batch: Yes: many meshes, one shared settings set, editable output name per row (SLeafCutDialog.cpp:768-783; LeafCutEditorModule.cpp:303-330)
workflow.inPlace: Optional for opaque output by naming the output like the source; confirmation says it can't be undone. Not allowed for assemblies (SLeafCutDialog.cpp:860-866,960-971)
workflow.notes: Mask is baked automatically from the material with MaterialBaking at the material's clip value (LeafCutOpacityMask.cpp:324-329,407); no mask texture/UV channel choice. No per-mesh or per-slot settings. Assembly falls back to opaque mesh when not worth it (LeafCutEditorModule.cpp:283-291). Solver tuning (FTuning, ~70 constants) is internal (LeafCutTuning.h:9-89).

outputs: Opaque static or skeletal mesh (keeps source type), Nanite optional (SLeafCutDialog.cpp:803-806)
Nanite Assembly: static mesh or skeletal mesh with branch bones (LeafCutAssembly.h:19-47)
Dynamic Wind skeletal data on skeletal assemblies if the engine Dynamic Wind plugin is enabled (LeafCutDynamicWind.cpp:242-244)
scripting: No BlueprintCallable/UFUNCTION or Python-visible API found

Assemblies require r.Nanite.Foliage and engine Nanite Assemblies (UE 5.7+) (SLeafCutDialog.cpp:936-941; README.txt:5)

entryPoints.label: New Foliage Recipe
entryPoints.where: Static meshes, multi-select; creates/finds <Mesh>_Recipe, analyses, opens. Source/FoliageToolkitPlus/Private/FoliageToolkitPlusModule.cpp:51-106

entryPoints.label: Foliage Recipe (asset editor: Viewport, Details, Regions, Atlas, Help)
Analyze (F7) / Convert (Ctrl+F7) / Place in level / Dump / Help (F1)
Project Settings > Plugins > Foliage Toolkit Plus / Foliage Toolkit Wind

workflow.model: Lite: interactive panel, one-shot output. Plus: persistent recipe asset + asset editor, re-convertible
workflow.storesSettings: Lite: no (Transient settings object, FoliageToolkitPanelSettings.h:10-16). Plus: yes, on UFoliageRecipe <Mesh>_Recipe, storing only overrides of automatic (FoliageRecipeAsset.h:184-189)
workflow.rerunnable: Plus: Convert any time; existing skeletal mesh is refilled so placed trees update (FoliageToolkitPlusLibrary.h:107-114; CHANGELOG.md:44). Lite: new uniquely named asset each cut
workflow.preview: Lite: Estimate runs the exact cut without saving and overlays it on the mask (FoliageCardCutter.h:53-60; SFoliageToolkitPanel.cpp:230-231). Plus: Analyze shows pieces/regions/skeleton without assets, wind preview, 17+ visualization modes (FoliageRecipeEditorCommands.cpp:74; FoliageRecipeEditor.h:120-161)
workflow.batch: Lite: one mesh per panel, batch only via script. Plus: context menu makes recipes for many meshes; batch convert via script/console (FoliageToolkitPlusModule.cpp:75-106)
workflow.inPlace: Never; source mesh is never modified (FoliageToolkitLibrary.h:148-152; FoliageToolkitPlusLibrary.h:50-54)
workflow.notes: Lite: per-slot checkboxes and hand-editable card shapes (Reset Shape / Reset All Edits). Plus: per-slot class map, per-region kind/wind group/frond bones/vector/alignment, per-piece overrides via JSON only (no editor UI found, unverified). Edits are undoable (FoliageRecipeEditor.cpp:867). Recipes export/import/diff/revert as JSON. Report JSON per mesh at <Project>/FoliageToolkit/<path>.report.json.

outputs: Lite: static mesh <Source>_Cut (unique name, duplicate of source; Nanite flag inherited, unverified) (FoliageToolkitLibrary.cpp:160-177)
Lite: <MI>_Opaque MICs, only when slot material is a MaterialInstanceConstant (FoliageToolkitLibrary.cpp:187-222)
Plus: Nanite assembly parts in <output>_Parts with a parts skeleton (FoliageAssembly.cpp:148,248,366-380)
Plus: Dynamic Wind data; shape preservation from project setting (FoliageTreeConverter.cpp:1144-1146). Opaque-material creation for Plus output not found (unverified)
Runtime: AFoliageWindTree actor (InstancedSkinnedMeshComponent + wind provider: Dynamic Wind or Toolkit wind on 5.8) (FoliageWindTree.h:15-78)
Debug: wind heat-map skeletal mesh copy (FoliageToolkitPlusLibrary.h:150-158)
scripting: UFoliageToolkitPlusLibrary: GetReportPath, FindRecipe, CreateRecipe, DumpRecipe, ApplyRecipe, AnalyzeTree, ConvertTree, AnalyzeRecipe, ConvertRecipe, DumpSavedRecipe, RevertRecipeToSaved, DiffRecipeTexts, MakeWindHeatMesh (FoliageToolkitPlusLibrary.h:72-158)

maskednanite.name: Masked Material to Nanite

entryPoints.label: Convert Mesh to Nanite
entryPoints.where: Editor Utility Blueprint Content/BP_ConvertToNanite (subclass of UMaskedMaterialToNaniteAction, UAssetActionUtility on UStaticMesh), category Nanite; engine shows a parameter dialog (unverified live). MaskedMaterialToNaniteAction.h:12-30; MaskedMaterialToNaniteAction.cpp:11-14

workflow.storesSettings: No (plugin stores nothing; whether the engine dialog remembers values is unverified)
workflow.rerunnable: Only after deleting/renaming the previous <Mesh>_Nanite; conversion fails if it exists (MeshScriptingUtilities.cpp:243-252)
workflow.batch: Yes: all selected static meshes, one shared options set and one shared slot-name->mask map, cancellable progress (MaskedMaterialToNaniteAction.cpp:16-43)
workflow.inPlace: No: always creates <Mesh>_Nanite next to the source
workflow.notes: User supplies a mask texture per material slot name; masked slots without a mask are not cut and keep their masked material (MeshScriptingUtilities.cpp:318-330). Clip value is entered manually, not read from the material (MeshScriptingUtilities.h:33-35). Non-masked slots are copied unchanged.

outputs: Static mesh <Mesh>_Nanite, Nanite enabled, default Nanite settings otherwise (MeshScriptingUtilities.cpp:372-385)
Opaque MICs <Material>_Opaque next to source material (or next to new mesh for engine content), reused if present (MeshScriptingUtilities.cpp:395-438)
No skeletal mesh, assembly, wind or runtime module (MaskedMaterialToNanite.uplugin:16-37)
scripting: ConvertMaskedMeshToNanite(Mesh, Masks, Options, bCreateOpaqueMaterials=true, bOptimizeMesh=false, Debug) BlueprintCallable (MeshScriptingUtilities.h:111-114)
ApplyMaskContoursToMesh(DynamicMesh, Mask, Options, Debug), Geometry Script building block (MeshScriptingUtilities.h:91-94)
ApplyMaskToMesh(DynamicMesh, Mask, UVSetIndex, MaskClipValue, ColorChannel, Debug), legacy per-vertex delete (MeshScriptingUtilities.h:76-79)

settings.name: MaskOptions.UVSetIndex

settings.name: MaskOptions.MaskClipValue
settings.tooltip: Mask values below this are cut away. Match it to the material's Opacity Mask Clip Value.

settings.name: MaskOptions.ColorChannel
settings.tooltip: Texture channel holding the mask

settings.name: MaskOptions.ContourTolerance
settings.tooltip: How far the outline may stray from the traced mask edge when simplified; 0 keeps every point

settings.name: MaskOptions.MinFeatureArea
settings.tooltip: Opaque islands smaller than this are dropped and smaller holes filled; 0 keeps all

settings.name: bCreateOpaqueMaterials
settings.tooltip: Make opaque copies of the masked materials for the output. Off in the action dialog; tick it or the output stays masked

settings.name: bOptimizeMesh
settings.tooltip: Merge coplanar triangles of the cut sections

limits: Traced texels max 2^28 per mesh UV extent, else error 'more than can be traced' (MaskContourCut.cpp:22-23,1561-1569)
UV seams can open; triangles without UVs on the chosen layer are kept unchanged (MaskContourCut.h:49-52)
Mask must be a Texture2D with readable, built source data; material-graph masks are not evaluated (MeshScriptingUtilities.cpp:53-93,110-114)
Platforms Win64, Linux, Mac; depends on GeometryScripting and MeshModelingToolset (MaskedMaterialToNanite.uplugin:21-46)
